pyqgis_plugin.name: RCL Web Package
pyqgis_plugin.description: Package a property's map (imagery and styled layers, clipped to its titles) for the RCL customer portal.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Select a property's titles, tick the layers to include, and build a web package: layers are drawn exactly as styled in QGIS and clipped to the property, with clickable features, photos and a legend. Preview it locally, then publish it to the portal and give customers access by email.
